tasks.title: A thoughtful follow-up for Northstar
tasks.description: Turn the discovery call commitments into a clear, source-backed next step for Morgan.
tasks.subject: Northstar — our next steps
tasks.body:
Hi Morgan,

Thank you for the thoughtful conversation. Based on our discovery session, we’ll share the revised direction on Friday and collect your team’s feedback before the next workshop.

I’ve brought the three open commitments together so we can keep the next steps clear. Please let me know if your priorities have shifted.

Best,
The Atelier team
